items.html: *The aforementioned phase of Ibur needed to be delayed and postponed for a period of twelve months, as mentioned in the Tikkunim, in the passage called "Kav HaMida" [the Measuring Line]. The reason is in order to correct all of Atzilut, which are twelve phases: Atik and his Nukva, AA and his Nukva, AVI Ilain, Yeshsut, ZON, and Yaakov and Leah. These are twelve complete Partzufim. Therefore this time of Ibur needed to be delayed for twelve months.
